shared_elements: upright monolithic form carved in low relief
schematic anthropomorphic figure with arms/hands rendered in shallow relief
horizontal band or belt-like register crossing the body
repeated smaller motifs arranged in a row
justification: Both are upright pillar-like bodies bearing shallow, flat relief motifs organised into horizontal registers, with schematic limbs/hands and small repeated signs, and both include disc- or knob-like round elements; the treatment is comparably flattened and schematic rather than modelled. But the depicted content differs fundamentally: A is a single colossal anthropomorphic figure with head, headdress, chest disc and belt, while B is dominated by profile animals (quadrupeds, birds, a serpentine form) and a chevron/net band, with no comparable frontal human face or torso emblems.
